description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'JsonBackedValueObject' that provides a base implementation for objects backed by a JSON structure, with methods for property retrieval and serialization support.

classes.name: JsonBackedValueObject
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for value objects that are stored as JSON, providing property access methods and JSON serialization support.
